subject: Is it pleiotropy or multiple QTLs in my phenotype?

messages.author: 49a67c6e0f03dace
messages.subject: Is it pleiotropy or multiple QTLs in my phenotype?
parts:
Hi Karl!

I recently performed interval mapping for melanin related phenotypes of one back-cross population under different conditions, and I got several QTLs  with totally different confidence interval (Bayes), as showed in the attached pictures (the squares are the confidence intervals, and the colours stand for different conditions). As some of the confidence interval are really closed (minimum difference are 3 cM), so I want to perform the multiple trait QTL mapping to see whether they are pleiotropy or multiple linked QTLs. 

When I used qtlpvl package to perform the qtl1v2 analysis (simulation=1000, method=fast), i got the result that p value is not significant and all these phenotypes have the same one QTL. 

So now I wonder in my result should I say all these phenotypes share the same QTL (as the multiple trait QTL mapping suggested) or should I say there are different genes involved (as the interval mapping results suggested) in these phenotypes? 

Thanks!
